lead.headline: Central Arkansas rates highest, and UT Arlington is 4-1
lead.deck: Nine schools from Kentucky to West Texas. Central Arkansas and UT Arlington are the only two in our national top 175.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the United Athletic Conference, nine schools from Richmond, Kentucky and Clarksville to Arlington and Abilene. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Central Arkansas rates highest in the league at 107th. The Bears beat Oral Roberts 85-55 on opening night and lost at Ole Miss and Arkansas.
UT Arlington (166th) is 4-1, with an 89-85 win over Portland and an 85-77 win over UTRGV on Saturday.
North Alabama won 79-75 at UC Davis on opening night, then lost at Oklahoma and at Miami.
Eastern Kentucky has scored at least 105 points in all three of its wins.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **127.** Central Arkansas' points against Ecclesia, the league's high.
**84-83.** Little Rock's overtime win over Northwestern State on Saturday, its first of the season.
**0.** Wins for West Georgia, which is 0-4.

notes.headline: Tarleton's close calls
notes.body: The Texans lost 96-90 in overtime at San Diego and beat Alcorn State 73-69 on Friday.

notes.headline: Austin Peay on the road
notes.body: The Governors lost 71-69 at Kennesaw State and by 16 at Wichita State.

notes.headline: Abilene Christian's week
notes.body: The Wildcats beat Lamar 83-81, then lost 76-71 at home to Stephen F. Austin.

notes.headline: One bid
notes.body: The UAC tournament in March decides the league's NCAA bid.
